name: debug-pro
author: 诺声(Logos)@SynomosAI
purpose_en: Triage-first debugging: locate the failing layer (input / environment / dependency / logic) before proposing any fix, then minimize, verify and regress.
purpose_zh: 先定位再动手的排障流程：先把故障钉在某一层（输入/环境/依赖/逻辑），再最小化、验证、回归。没有日志与复现步骤就不给根因。
use_when_en: Use when a build fails, a regression appears, a bug cannot be reproduced, or you must decide whether the fault is in code, environment or data.
use_when_zh: 构建失败、出现回归、缺陷无法复现，或需判断故障位于代码、环境还是数据时使用。
outputs_en: An evidence table (exception type, last stack frame, exit code, HTTP status, timestamp), a redacted environment block, and a repro score with missing items named.
outputs_zh: 证据表（异常类型/末栈帧/退出码/HTTP 状态/时间戳）、已脱敏的环境块、复现报告评分与缺失项点名。

verification.differentiator: single checkable command handed to the user for every claim
